name: claude-dev-pipeline
description: A four-agent feature pipeline for Claude Code: plan, implement, test, review.

plugins.name: dev-pipeline
plugins.description: Chains a Planner, Coder, Tester, and read-only Reviewer into one /pipeline command. Agents hand off through files in .pipeline/, and the run halts at open questions, failing tests, or a non-SHIP verdict.
